selection: Every actually retained empirical resolution; arbitrary number. No old four-level family and no forced six/seven tiers.

geometry.primary: Exact model membership of source NP points. Geographic functional boundary between points remains unknown.
geometry.national: Every retained resolution has national exact-membership colors and structural-class visual summary, observed source-frame/unknown-location page, actual core symbols.
geometry.zoom: All own-observed2021 formal cities >=1million plus exactly source-admitted MOW/SPB context anchors, two panels/page. Every member of the selected actual resolution/unit determines full projected bounds; no quantile trimming of distant members.
geometry.schematic_lines: Only source member/core endpoint segments, explicitly not roads/flows/borders. No filled hulls, Voronoi territories, buffers or inferred NP footprint.
geometry.basemap: Optional source-pinned Natural Earth coastline for orientation only. No claimed functional/admin boundary from coastline.
geometry.projection: WGS84 to Albers50/70N lon0=100; full finite valid coordinates shown; unknown coordinates retained in ledgers/counters. Antimeridian coastline jump segments broken.

typology.primary_type: Every actual output unit must exactly join one measured primary_type_id/name; unit_role preserved. Full codes and frequencies for all resolutions/roles are exported; never silently Other/truncate.
typology.visual_summary: Point color structural_class only; labels explicitly call this a visual component, not the full classification. All primary-code frequency points are plotted and full type_counts.csv retained.
typology.unit_membership_colors: Repeatable hash colors illustrate membership; not a unique color-to-ID registry. Exact identifiers are in exact_memberships.csv and unit_type_registry.csv.
typology.roles: Territorial units, protected carry/atomic residuals, context overlays counted separately; mandatory classification does not establish equal confidence or causal mechanism.

source_quality.2010: Explicit normalizer fields primary2010_population_share/protected_secondary2010_population_share. Denominator known nonnegative additive member population2010; denominator<=0/allmissing gives NA, never zero. Nonadditive central unknown slots remain separately scoped in registry.
source_quality.2021: National native own observed source_record_id_2021+knownpopulation frame vs other source records; map validity counted separately from candidate eligibility.
source_quality.extent: Observed native geometry/route unknown counters and full direct-time/geodesic distributions; no false equivalence with whole-city completeness.

diagnostics.objective: Exact saved merge_index/Q per tested cap; no decorative substitute values. Caps never renamed geographic levels.
diagnostics.knees: Every tested candidate cap decision, including short/no-knee/unstable outcomes. Exact source rule and conditional-stability denominator apply; map code does not choose thresholds.
diagnostics.bootstrap: All50 outcomes per cap required, all cap sets exactly match knee table. All available ARI plotted and unavailable ARI leftNA. Current prospective admission may require >=40/50; no failed-replicate zero imputation or exclusion.
diagnostics.engineering: Knee/modularity/conditional potential engineering clearly distinguished from observed commuting and not attributed as geographic authors' algorithm.

pages.national_pages: One for each actual retained resolution.
pages.over_budget_policy: Preflight actual cardinalities before final rendering. If actual count exceeds30, explicit versioned multi-panel redesign reviewed before render; never omit a level/city/code or force hierarchy to fit page count. If legitimate actual content below20, report true count and add only useful source-backed diagnostics under reviewed amendment, no invented levels.

admission: Before actual draw require frozen sources/SHA, actual hierarchy and complete-typology independent output admissions and actual map preregistration reviewed by guardian. Synthetic tests are labeled and never substituted for actual atlas.
verification: Unique exact joins, no double primary membership within resolution, all units typed, all sources+code+config unchanged through export, every membership including missing coords exported, PDF Cyrillic text and page count, actual visual review of national/zoom/diagnostics before adoption.
limitations: National graphic cannot visually name thousands of distinct membership IDs or hundreds of compound types simultaneously; exact registries remain the inspectable source of identity. No accepted morphology polygons presently available.
changes: Ctx-focalordinary/ruralcatchment remains territorial_unit; externalcenter_scope ownPunknown andwholecompleteFALSE; notautomaticallyoverlay.
component_integration: Every actual config declares which accepted source versions are physically included in the displayed hierarchy versus accepted sources awaiting routing/provider/model integration. No acceptance-to-integration inference.
population_frames: Full population source view and admitted additive/context geographic partition have distinct explicit denominators; excluded nonadditive duplicate context/source rows are disclosed.
display_dictionary: Structural display aliases are cartographic text only; exact original structural_class/type codes preserved, dictionary exported. protected_carry means no confirmed functional attachment, not2010 confidentiality.
